Hi all

Introducing myself before going further. And sorry if this is not the right way to surface this topic (new here).

I'm an indie researcher (management consultant, no academic affiliation, no formal math training) directing a small Lean 4 multi-agent AI setup. I've read the contribution guide and I'm aware of the April 2026 policy on LLM-generated code from new contributors. I am not proposing PRs to mathlib at this stage.

Posting for two reasons:

Prior-art check: The project includes VP/VNP foundations in the Bürgisser–Clausen–Shokrollahi §5.2 style, permanent ∈ VNP via Ryser (0 axioms, explicit circuit size 2n²+5n+2), a local monodromy / multivalued-analytic stack built to discharge axioms in a formalization of Smith's EML rebuttal, and an obstruction-theory framework (MinimalBasis) with EML, NAND, and polynomial-activation networks as instantiations. I couldn't locate prior Lean/Coq/Isabelle/AFP work on VP/VNP or Ryser specifically — if I missed something, I'd much rather be told before describing this publicly elsewhere.

Shape question: Given the AI-direction setup, the right shape is presumably a standalone repository with mathlib as a dependency, per the contribution guide. Is that the correct read?

Files: https://f675783c.math-team.pages.dev/proofs
You have defined a formula. Your definition of size computes the size of a formula. You make no distinction between formula size and circuit size.

Thank you so much for the feedback, Shreyas. Really appreciated.
Honestly, I’m a little bit out of my depth at this point; but I’ll added it to my roadmap and see if we can figure out how to solve it.
I will leave the repo here, just in case anyone finds it useful at some moment. I will be moving on to other projects: https://github.com/dangoodface/matrix-foundations
This topic was moved here from #lean4 > VP/VNP, algebraic complexity by Kevin Buzzard.
@Daniel Buenrostro please don't double-post, and please read the descriptions of the channels before you post in them.
